doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 在健康年轻和中年成人中，睡前完成的急性晚间运动（无论强度如何）不会扰乱后续睡眠。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 急性晚间高强度运动（HIE）显著缩短REM睡眠比例。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 急性晚间中等强度运动（MIE）结合骑行可增加REM潜伏期。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 急性晚间运动不扰乱总睡眠时间（TST），无论运动强度如何。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 急性晚间低强度运动（LIE）可能是改善入睡潜伏期（SOL）的最佳方式。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 急性晚间中等强度运动（MIE）最大程度减少入睡后觉醒时间（WASO）。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 急性晚间低强度和中等强度运动改善睡眠效率（SE），而高强度运动降低SE。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 健康青年和中年无睡眠障碍的成人，晚间运动（无论强度）在睡前完成不会破坏后续睡眠。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)

entries.claim: 制定睡眠卫生建议时，应考虑晚间运动的类型和时长。
entries.source_doc: Different Intensities of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
entries.org: 自然与睡眠科学 (Nature and Science of Sleep)
